question: In which of the following years was the Gandhi-Irwin Pact signed with the government agreeing to release all political prisoners?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1931**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Gandhi-Irwin Pact was signed on March 5, **1931**.
 
• This pact was an agreement between Mahatma Gandhi and the then Viceroy of India, Lord Irwin.
 
• The pact marked the end of the Civil Disobedience Movement in India.
 
• As per the agreement, the British government agreed to release all political prisoners who had not committed violence.
 
• Gandhi agreed to attend the Second Round Table Conference in London as a representative of the Indian National Congress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Civil Disobedience Movement**

 
 
• Launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1930 to protest against the British rule in India.
 
• Included acts of non-violent resistance and non-cooperation with the British authorities.
 
 
 
• **Round Table Conferences**
 
 
• Series of three conferences held in London to discuss constitutional reforms in India.
 
• Gandhi attended the Second Round Table Conference as part of the Gandhi-Irwin Pact.
 
 
 
• **Lord Irwin**
 
 
• He was the Viceroy of India from 1926 to 1931.
 
• Played a significant role in negotiating with Indian leaders during the freedom struggle.
